title: A picked cut opens from a chevron on its track header, as the transition mock draws it
goal: In the transition walkthrough the cut opens into its two clips from a small chevron on the V1 track label. Today it opens only from its right-click, the Clip menu and Option E, because the arrow already on the track label opens the track's keyed-value lanes. While a cut is picked, the track label shows a second chevron, beside that arrow, that opens and closes the cut (settled on 2026-10-20, when the waiting cards were taken as recommended).
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transition-wt.html line 376 #btnExpand (.xbtn chevron-down in the V1 .tl), step 5 data-cue #btnExpand. Today: TimelineTrackRows.swift twist (hasKeyLanes / hasParts arrow). Expand the Cut itself shipped in a-cut-opens-into-its-two-clips-on-their-own-rows (EditorState+ExpandedCut.toggleExpandedCut, ExpandedCutRows). Walk to extend: Scripts/playtest/expand-the-cut-from-its-menus-walk.json.
acceptance: With a cut picked, the track label shows a second chevron beside the existing arrow; with no cut picked it is not there
That chevron opens and closes the A and B rows, and the existing arrow still opens the key lanes
A walk at Next defaults clicks that control at a point on its face and measures the rows open, then closed
